instruction_ref: CEO direct 2026-11-25: 'ではそのように実装を。指定範囲外は触るな。' following the three COO safety defects
instruction: Within Sellemy alone, add product recall screening ahead of product acceptance with official manufacturer/government source evidence and bounded product substitution, independent completed-article Safety QA that rejects hazardous use cases and removal of mandatory supervision, and a separate daily postpublication recall-monitor process. Mandatory safety receipts bind the exact article and evidence, are checked at prepublication, and never accept a recalled product or stale approval. Detect the rain-boots floodwater wording, tire-inflator oversight language, and Anker Soundcore 3 recall without blanket keyword banning. Persist postpublication findings as actionable alerts for CEO review, not automatic edits to live articles. All other existing QA, publication approval and site behavior unchanged.
implementer: Direct Mac Studio staged editing, no Codex-generated code changes
preserved_rules: No modification of already published article content or production approval settings
No change to unrelated Growth, note, LINE, Purpose Hub or portal behavior
Product QA, Editorial QA, Claim QA, QA certification and CEO review remain mandatory
Unconfirmed search results never count as verified recall evidence; source URLs must be official
Source outages block only safety-critical product classes, not normal low-risk recommendations
A potential recall triggers a targeted product hold/reselection, not an irreversible global NG designation
Daily monitoring only creates recorded safety alerts; any live publication change remains subject to the existing CEO gate
